subject: Request: year-end community bounty credits for OpenLedger
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha@openledger.org>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoood.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: year-end community bounty credits for OpenLedger

Hi Rishi,

Hope you're well — I'm Asha (maintainer at the OpenLedger Project). We're running a small holiday bug-bounty style sprint for contributors (Dec 1–15) to triage and patch high-priority issues. A handful of new contributors will rely on hosted inference for local tests; our current free tier will not cover the expected peak.

Can Redwood issue a short-term credits allocation or trial extension for the project so we can cover roughly 75k tokens of inference usage (estimated across ~10 contributors) for the two-week window? This is community-focused — not a commercial engagement.

I've attached a two-page plan that outlines contributor counts and the test prompts we'll use. If possible, we need the credits in place by Nov 29 to allow onboarding.

Attachment: openledger-bounty-plan.pdf (application/pdf)
Also attaching a small usage snapshot from our CI: usage-snapshot.csv (text/csv)

Thanks — appreciate any help.

Best,
Asha Rao
OpenLedger Project — Lead Maintainer
https://openledger.org

From: rishi_malhotra@redwoood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwoood.ai, marissa_cole@redwoood.ai
Cc: Asha Rao <asha@openledger.org>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: year-end community bounty credits for OpenLedger

 forwarding Asha's request — short ask: 75k tokens for a 2-week window (Dec 1–15) to support contributor onboarding. They are a well-known OSS project; this is community support (no commercial contract).

Can finance/ops create a one-off promo or top-up for the project and apply it to their org ID? If you need more data, the attached plan has estimated contributor counts and sample prompts.

If we can approve, I'd like to:
 - Allocate 75k tokens to OpenLedger org ID (promo or direct top-up)
 - Set expiry to 2026-12-31 to keep it bounded
 - Notify Asha with setup instructions and console link

Thanks — Rishi

From: priyom_das@redwoood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoood.ai, Asha Rao <asha@openledger.org>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 07:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: year-end community bounty credits for OpenLedger

Thanks for the context, Rishi — reviewed the plan and quick CI snapshot. This fits our community credits guardrails.

We can approve a one-time allocation: 75,000 token-equivalent credits (redeemable against hosted inference) with expiry 2026-12-31. I'll create a promo code tied to the OpenLedger org and post the allocation in the console.

Action items I completed:
- Allocated 75,000 token-equivalent credits and generated promo: OPENLEDGER-2026-HOLIDAY
- Set expiry: 2026-12-31 23:59 UTC
- Applied internal tag: community_credits; reason: OSS holiday bounty support

Notes / links:
- Credits page: https://console.redwood.inference/projects/openledger/credits/allocations/REQ-8721
- Promo code: OPENLEDGER-2026-HOLIDAY (apply at org billing or send to me and I'll attach)

Asha — please confirm you received the code. If you want us to auto-apply it to the org, reply with the OpenLedger org ID (or confirm we should attach to maintainer email as fallback).

Marissa — marking this as community support for reporting. If you want to review the tag or adjust the amount, let me know this morning and I can update before applying.

-Priyom
Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwoood.ai
To: Asha Rao <asha@openledger.org>
Cc: priyom_das@redwoood.ai, marissa_cole@redwoood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: year-end community bounty credits for OpenLedger

Asha — great news: we approved and the promo has been generated. Details below.

Summary:
- Promo code: OPENLEDGER-2026-HOLIDAY
- Amount: 75,000 token-equivalent credits
- Expiry: 2026-12-31 23:59 UTC
- How to use: In your org billing page, click "Apply promo" and paste the code. If you'd like, I can apply it for you if you share your OpenLedger org ID or confirm to attach to this email address.

Links:
- Allocation record: https://console.redwood.inference/projects/openledger/credits/allocations/REQ-8721
- Onboarding guide for contributors: https://docs.redwood.inference/self-serve/onboarding#teams (short checklist included)

We included a short note on the allocation tagging that this is an OSS community support grant. Priyom — thanks for processing this quickly.

Asha — if you hit any friction when applying the code, reply and we'll either apply it directly or create a temporary organization-level link. Best of luck with the bounty — excited to see what the community ships.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Manager, Community Programs
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwoood.ai
